Description: Security Group config for AWS EC2 Linux SSH Setup project

Inbound.Description: Allow SSH from your trusted IP only — replace YOUR_IP with your actual IP

Notes: Never open SSH (port 22) to 0.0.0.0/0 — always restrict to your IP
Get your current IP: curl https://checkip.amazonaws.com
Use RSA key pairs for passwordless, secure authentication
Rotate key pairs periodically for better security
